findings.rule: A shortcode is two to five lowercase letters.
findings.input: A shortcodes.json with the text {"sk\n": "pandoscope/skills"}: the key is the letters sk followed by a line feed.
findings.finding: The schema's pattern `^[a-z]{2,5}$` is matched with Python's `re.search`, where `$` also matches before a final line feed, so the loader and `pandoscope shortcodes check` accept the shortcode `sk\n` and return it as written although it is not two to five lowercase letters.

findings.rule: Two shortcodes for one repository fail, and the message names both.
findings.finding: The loader compares repositories by their exact spelling, so two shortcodes for one forge repository written in two letter cases load without an error, while `_check_origin` in review.py treats the same two spellings as one repository.

findings.rule: A role without a name pattern (orchestrator, general, probe) names a pass too; its value is not checked.
findings.input: An order with `role: probe`, `id: probe-opus-4`, `model_tier: opus`, a subject with a shortcode and `pass: Look_1`.
findings.finding: The order schema applies the pattern `^[a-z0-9-]+$` to the pass of every role, so the order check fails this probe order on the value of its pass although the value of a pass of a role without a name pattern is not checked.
